nextStoryContext: US-002 added .devcontainer/init-firewall.sh: idempotent default-deny egress firewall using iptables + ipset. Allowlist is exactly 7 domains declared in a single ALLOWED_DOMAINS bash array: api.anthropic.com, claude.ai, platform.claude.com, github.com, *.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, raw.githubusercontent.com. No downloads.claude.ai or storage.googleapis.com. Script flushes all chains before applying (idempotent), sets -P OUTPUT DROP, and includes a self-verify step (allowed domain reachable + blocked domain denied). Requires NET_ADMIN+NET_RAW capabilities (to be granted by US-003 devcontainer.json runArgs). CI is macos-latest with no Docker: do NOT run iptables in tests. All quality gates green (2290 pass / 0 fail). US-003 is next (devcontainer.json).
